title: Iru Endpoint Management, formerly Kandji (Enterprise API, API token with GET permissions only)
readScopes: An Iru Endpoint Management API token (Settings > Access > Add API Token) whose permissions are these five GET endpoints only: GET /api/v1/devices (List Devices), GET /api/v1/devices/{device_id}/status (Get Device Status), GET /api/v1/prism/application_firewall, GET /api/v1/prism/gatekeeper_and_xprotect and GET /api/v1/prism/startup_settings. The token is KANDJI_API_TOKEN; the tenant API URL (https://<subdomain>.api.kandji.io, or .api.eu.kandji.io in the EU) is KANDJI_API_URL.

checks.title: Each Mac has FileVault on
checks.scope: Every Mac in the tenant, one result per Mac, from List Devices filtered by filevault_enabled=true and =false; a Mac in neither list is skipped.

checks.title: Each Mac runs macOS at or above the given minimum version
checks.scope: Every Mac, from os_version against --kandji-min-os; without that option the check is skipped. Apple's support dates are not looked up.

checks.title: Each Mac's agent has checked in within the last 14 days
checks.scope: Every Mac, from last_check_in (the agent check-in); the window is --kandji-checkin-days.

checks.title: Each Mac is enrolled in MDM
checks.scope: Every Mac, from mdm_enabled in List Devices.

checks.title: No Blueprint library item on the Mac is in error or failed to install
checks.scope: Every Mac, from Get Device Status library_items: ERROR or failed fails, PASS or success passes; pending, excluded, available and incompatible items are not judged, and a Mac with none judged is skipped.

checks.title: No Blueprint parameter on the Mac fails its audit
checks.scope: Every Mac, from Get Device Status parameters: ERROR (audit failure) or WARNING (a muted alert) fails, PASS or REMEDIATED passes; pending and incompatible parameters are not judged.

checks.title: The macOS application firewall is on
checks.scope: Every Mac with a row in Prism's Application firewall category, from its status field; a Mac with no row is skipped.

checks.title: Gatekeeper is on
checks.scope: Every Mac with a row in Prism's Gatekeeper and XProtect category, from gatekeeper_status. XProtect's version is not judged.

checks.title: System Integrity Protection is enabled
checks.scope: Every Mac with a row in Prism's Startup settings category, from sip.
